note: A mile below the Clearwater Lake dam, in a bend of the Spring Branch (no swimming in it); every site has some shade. Pool, playground and an RC car track; cabins and a camper for rent. --Claude
summary: Operator pages (2026): $28-40 RV sites for 2, open all year, 60 numbered sites; waterfront riverfront -> creekside (the stream around the park is NHD 'Brewer Bay' / the park's 'Spring Branch', ~10-25 m wide; the Black River is 0.8-1 km away). Phone 573-223-4217 -> 573-979-4405.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> creekside: the water wrapping the campground is not the Black River. USGS NHD names it 'Brewer Bay', a single-line perennial stream (FCode 46006) passing 38 m from the pin, while the Black River's channel runs 0.8 km west and 1 km south. The park calls it 'the Spring Branch'. Imagery: ~10-15 m wide on the north arm under canopy and ~20-25 m on the open east arm by the pads, under the ~30 m river line. The pads on the bend still sit on the open bank per the stored evidence, so creekside rather than lower. Campspot's 'Waterfront' site types are consistent with that.
PHONE 573-223-4217 -> 573-979-4405: the contact page and FAQ give (573) 979-4405, and so does Google; the stored number appears nowhere on the operator site.
SITES: count 60 from the 2026 map (includes tent sites; the RV/tent split is not stated).
BELOW THE DAM: the park is a mile below Clearwater Dam, so there is no lake value; nothing claims one.
PIN 37.1289,-90.7471 sits on the camp loop in the stream bend, ~75 m east of Google's 37.12881,-90.74794 - fine.
Not re-read: Campspot's live prices and the $5 reservation fee (the 2026-10-13 read stands; the operator rates page agrees).
